g.text: A guest leaving on the 5th and one arriving
on the 5th do not share the room.
date, but on early check-out it is the actual
check-out date — so the room is released.
Bookability and cleaning state are separate.
A room can be available for letting
and at the same time need cleaning.
The old system had one field for both —
and it disagreed with its own user interface.
RoomSize is a category, not a rate.
Without a price, revenue cannot be computed.
Today the system does not know who is acting.
